Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us
The findings indicate a urinary tract infection (UTI) with significant pyuria, bacteriuria, positive nitrites, and hematuria, confirmed by >100,000 CFU/mL E. coli in urine culture. The low specific gravity may suggest dilute urine. No ketones or casts are present. Clinical correlation and appropriate antibiotic therapy are recommended.
